definitions.gloss: to roll up; to turn up; to flip up
definitions.explanation: To fold or push something upward, such as rolling up sleeves, turning up a skirt hem, or flipping up a cover. Combines めくる (to flip/turn) with 上げる (upward).

examples.japanese: ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくり{上|あ}げた。
⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくり{上|あ}げて⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I rolled up my pant legs and waded into the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくり{上|あ}げる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丸|まる}く→丸い：02967_marui⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{寝|ね}ていた→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: When I flipped up the futon, I found the cat curled up asleep underneath.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: めくる (to flip, to turn over) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (upward). Sometimes written with kanji as ⟦{捲|めく}り→捲る：02310_mekuru⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧, but the hiragana form is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくり{上|あ}げる (to roll up one's sleeves)
- ⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくり{上|あ}げる (to roll up a hem)
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくり{上|あ}げる (to flip up a futon/blanket)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- まくり{上|あ}げる: to roll up — synonym with slightly different nuance; ⟦まくる→まくる：19421_makuru⟧ emphasizes gathering up
- めくる: to flip, to turn — the base verb without the upward direction
- たくし{上|あ}げる: to tuck up — used especially for skirts and kimono
